title: IVG Pro Salts Red Freeze 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Red Freeze 10ml E-Liquid offers a brilliant balance of sweet summer fruit and sharp winter chill. The profile leads with the tart, mouth-watering notes of Redcurrants and a broader medley of juicy Red Berries, creating a highly vibrant fruit inhale. To finish, a deeply cooling infusion of Ice and Menthol sweeps across the palate, ensuring a clean, brisk, and entirely refreshing exhale. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the sharp, frosty berries of Red Freeze, vapers can explore other standout options such as the sparkling notes of Lemon Fizz or the layered sweetness of Strawberry Raspberry Cherry, ensuring a premium choice for every preference.
